description: On the desk in front of you there’s a black power strip near the back corner with several cables lying loose, including a coiled USB cable in the foreground. The left hand stays planted near the power strip to steady it as the right hand picks up a USB plug, guides it toward the strip, pushes it into a port, then adjusts and releases the cable so it drapes across the desk while the strip remains a left-hand object and the USB plug is a right-hand object during insertion.
